controles.affirmation: hook + titre : "Le bonus variable des dirigeants au titre de 2025 a ete paye a 148% de la cible, dont 30% du critere porte explicitement sur les parts de marche ; l'annee 2025 a pourtant vu un recul de la part de marche"
controles.verbatim_source: "All Named Executive Officers in the 2022-2024 LTIP cycle had goals in addition to the Company Performance Goal. The award for R. P. Feight was based 30 percent on strategic goals focused on market share growth, parts sales and PACCAR's emerging technologies strategy development. The Committee determined that R. P. Feight exceeded each goal and approved an overall payout of 148 percent of target. ... The long-term cash awards for the 2023-2025 LTIP cycle have not been determined as of the date of this proxy statement" (DEF 14A 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Les 148% se rapportent au cycle d'interessement long terme 2022-2024, pas a la prime 2025 ; ils ne concernent que le directeur general (les autres dirigeants : 147,5% a 168%). Le cycle 2023-2025, celui qui couvrirait l'annee de recul, n'etait pas encore determine a la date du proxy. Reformuler ou supprimer l'argument : le rapprochement temporel avec la perte de parts de marche 2025 n'existe pas.

controles.affirmation: "Le carnet de commandes de production s'etablissait a 4,9 Mds$ fin 2025, contre 7,6 Mds$ fin 2024 ... sa baisse de 36% en un an"
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company had a total production backlog of $4.9 billion at the end of 2025. Within this backlog, orders scheduled for delivery within three months (90 days) are considered to be firm. The 90-day backlog approximated $2.6 billion at December 31, 2025, $3.8 billion at December 31, 2024 and $7.6 billion at December 31, 2023." (10-K FY2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Comparaison de deux grandeurs differentes a deux dates differentes : 4,9 Mds$ est le carnet TOTAL fin 2025 ; 7,6 Mds$ est le carnet a 90 JOURS au 31 decembre 2023. La seule comparaison valide est le carnet 90 jours : 2,6 Mds$ fin 2025 contre 3,8 Mds$ fin 2024, soit -32%. Le -36% affiche est sans fondement.

controles.affirmation: "un niveau que le groupe lui-meme qualifie de plus bas depuis 2016" (repete dans le titre, l'argument, le resume et le bloc quantitatif)
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence dans le 10-K FY2025 ni dans le 10-Q T2 2026. La seule mention de "2016" dans le 10-K est : "On July 19, 2016, the European Commission (EC) concluded its investigation of all major European truck manufacturers".
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer. L'attribution au groupe ("qualifie lui-meme") est infondee. La date 2016 semble provenir d'une confusion avec le reglement de la Commission europeenne.

controles.affirmation: "Litige europeen deja chiffre a 350 M$" : "Le groupe a deja comptabilise une charge de 350 M$ avant impots (264,5 M$ apres impots) au premier trimestre 2025 pour ces reclamations EC"
controles.verbatim_source: "In the first quarter 2023, the Company recorded a pre-tax charge of $600.0 ($446.4 after-tax) for the estimable total cost. The Company has settled with a significant majority of claimants and continues to pursue appropriate resolutions. Due to ongoing settlement costs, the Company updated its estimate and recorded an ADDITIONAL pre-tax charge of $350.0 ($264.5 after-tax) for the total estimable remaining costs ... in the first quarter of 2025." (10-Q T2 2026, Note M)
controles.correction_proposee: Le cumul comptabilise est de 950 M$ avant impots (600 M$ au T1 2023 + 350 M$ au T1 2025), pas 350 M$. L'ATT sous-estime son propre argument. Mentionner aussi que le groupe indique avoir transige avec une large majorite des demandeurs.

controles.affirmation: "les immatriculations europeennes de plus de 16 tonnes ont recule de 297 000 a 316 100 unites sur la meme periode"
controles.verbatim_source: "The over 16-tonne truck market in Europe in 2025 decreased to 297,000 units from 316,100 units in 2024" (10-K FY2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Sens inverse : le marche est passe de 316 100 unites (2024) a 297 000 (2025). Ecrire "ont recule de 316 100 a 297 000 unites".

controles.affirmation: titre : "Contraction du marche mondial des camions"
controles.verbatim_source: "The over 16-tonne truck market in Europe in the first six months of 2026 was 165,000 units compared to 151,100 units in the first six months of 2025." (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Sur la periode la plus recente (S1 2026), le marche europeen >16 t PROGRESSE de 9%. La contraction est nord-americaine et bresilienne, pas mondiale. Restreindre le titre. Par ailleurs le bloc "preuve" cite des projections de marche sud-americain qui n'etayent aucune des deux affirmations chiffrees du paragraphe.

controles.affirmation: "le taux de penetration du financement captif PFS recule egalement (24,7% contre 25,9%)" presente comme donnee des "six premiers mois de 2026"
controles.verbatim_source: "In the second quarter of 2026, PFS finance market share of new PACCAR truck sales was 24.7% compared to 25.9% in the same period of 2025. In the first six months of 2026, PFS finance market share ... was 24.5% compared to 25.3%"
controles.correction_proposee: 24,7% / 25,9% sont les chiffres du DEUXIEME TRIMESTRE. Sur les six premiers mois, c'est 24,5% contre 25,3%. Corriger la periode ou le chiffre.

controles.affirmation: Parts de marche S1 2026 : lourd US/Canada 29,6% vs 30,4% ; moyen tonnage 12,3% vs 14,0% ; DAF Europe >16 t 13,6% vs 14,2% ; DAF 6-16 t 9,2% vs 9,9% ; DAF Bresil 7,6% vs 9,4%
controles.verbatim_source: "The Company's heavy-duty truck retail market share was 29.6% in the first six months of 2026 compared to 30.4% ... medium-duty market share was 12.3% ... compared to 14.0% ... DAF over 16-tonne market share was 13.6% ... compared to 14.2% ... DAF market share in the 6 to 16-tonne market ... was 9.2% compared to 9.9% ... DAF Brasil market share ... 7.6% compared to 9.4%"

controles.affirmation: Marge brute Camions 7,5% en 2025 contre 13,9% en 2024, redressee a 9,4% au T2 2026 ; marge Pieces stable autour de 30%
controles.verbatim_source: "Truck gross margin was 7.5% in 2025 compared to 13.9% in 2024" (10-K) ; "Truck gross margin was 9.4% in the second quarter of 2026 compared to 8.7% in the same period of 2025" ; "Parts gross margin was 29.9% in 2025 compared to 30.9% in 2024"
controles.correction_proposee: Exact mais selectif : sur le SEMESTRE 2026 la marge Camions recule (8,3% contre 9,2% au S1 2025). Le "redressement" n'existe qu'au T2 isole.

controles.affirmation: Provisions pour pertes sur creances PFS 39,4 M$ au T2 2026 contre 29,2 M$ (+35%) ; citation conditionnelle sur les conditions de fret
controles.verbatim_source: "Provision for losses on receivables | 39.4 | 29.2" ; "If freight transportation conditions decline due to a weaker economy, then past due accounts, truck repossessions and credit losses would likely increase from the current levels"
controles.correction_proposee: Exact et le conditionnel du filing est bien preserve. Signaler que le meme paragraphe indique "The used truck market is improving".

controles.affirmation: Ventes retail lourds US/Canada 232 800 unites en 2025 contre 268 100 en 2024 (-13%)
controles.verbatim_source: "In 2025, industry retail sales in the heavy-duty market in the U.S. and Canada was 232,800 units compared to 268,100 units in 2024"

controles.affirmation: Effectifs environ 25 900 fin 2025 contre environ 30 100 fin 2024 (-14%), source "10-K FY2025"
controles.verbatim_source: "On December 31, 2025, the Company had approximately 25,900 employees" (10-K FY2025) ; "approximately 30,100 employees" (10-K FY2024, depose le 19/02/2025)
controles.correction_proposee: Chiffres exacts, mais le 30 100 ne figure PAS dans le 10-K FY2025 cite en source : il vient du 10-K FY2024. Corriger la source.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration totale du CEO en baisse de 27% ; approbation say-on-pay a 93%
controles.verbatim_source: Table de remuneration : 12 618 865 $ (2025) contre 17 364 223 $ (2024) = -27,3% ; "In 2025, PACCAR stockholders voted ... with over 93 percent of the shares voted in favor of "Say on Pay.""
